profile.title: Computer Engineer
profile.intro: I design, build and ship web products from database to interface. My work centres on React, Node.js and cloud infrastructure, with a focus on speed, accessibility and code a team can maintain.

bio: I am Natnael Girma, an Electrical and Computer Engineering student at Hawassa University, Ethiopia, passionate about AI, software engineering, cybersecurity, and innovative technology. I enjoy building solutions that combine intelligent software with engineering to solve real-world problems. Through projects such as VoiceBridge Vision and ElectraAI, I aim to develop practical technologies that improve accessibility, efficiency, and everyday life. I am committed to continuous learning, discipline, faith, and personal growth as I work toward becoming an accomplished engineer, entrepreneur, and technology innovator.
about.goals: I am looking to lead product engineering on a team that values craft, and to keep growing in system design, developer experience and applied AI.
strengths: Owns features end to end, from schema to UI
Writes clear docs and reviews that unblock teammates
Cuts load times and cloud costs with measured changes
